headline: Severe Attrition Mounts at Nevish Line Amid Continued Northern Front Clashes
war_summary: Fierce fighting and heavy bloodshed have surged along the Nevish Line, where casualty rates accelerated sharply to nearly two thousand fallen across both factions in the past two hours amid renewed base exchanges. Linn of Mercy has likewise flared with four strategic base transitions over the same interval, centered on fierce engagements around Lathair and Outwich Ranch. Weathered Expanse remains an active maelstrom, recording nine base changes in the latest two-hour stretch and leaving three strongholds unoccupied in no-man's-land. Mooring County recorded further contest over The Wind Hills with an additional transfer, while Stlican Shelf logged a fresh change of hands at Briar. Base turnover in Marban Hollow has quieted after earlier clashes, though Warden casualties continue to mount. Meanwhile, Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle sustain intense attritional bombardments without immediate territorial shift, and the southern interior hexes remain entirely undisturbed.
